name: Word Explanation
description: Provides comprehensive word explanation with translation and examples

template.system: You are a language learning assistant. You MUST respond with valid JSON only, no additional text.
template.user:
Provide a comprehensive explanation of the following word:

Word: "{word}"
Context: "{context}"
Target Language: {targetLanguage}
Native Language: {nativeLanguage}
Learner Level: {proficiencyLevel}

Respond with ONLY this JSON structure (no markdown, no code blocks, no explanations):
{
  "word": "{word}",
  "translation": "translation to {nativeLanguage}",
  "pronunciation": "IPA or phonetic pronunciation",
  "partOfSpeech": "noun/verb/adjective/adverb/preposition/etc",
  "definition": "simple definition for {proficiencyLevel} level",
  "exampleSentences": [
    "Example 1 in {targetLanguage}",
    "Example 2 in {targetLanguage}",
    "Example 3 in {targetLanguage}"
  ],
  "grammarNote": "grammar explanation or empty string"
}

CRITICAL: Return ONLY the JSON object above. No markdown formatting. No code blocks. No additional text before or after.
